title: still present since round 3: entering demo clobbers a live landlord session; exit downgrades auth to NotAsked
evidence:
enter_demo: 'Model(
          ..model,
          route:,
          auth: Success(landlord),
          csrf_token: "demo-csrf-token",' — unconditional overwrite. clear_demo_state: 'demo_mode: False,
    demo_store: None,
    auth: NotAsked,'
detail: A logged-in landlord who opens /demo loses SPA session state and exits to auth NotAsked, forcing a client-side re-auth despite an intact session cookie. Unchanged from r3 (carried since round 2).
recommended_fix: Preserve the pre-demo auth on entry and restore it on exit, or re-check session on exit.

title: still present since round 3: demo exit from a dirty edit page clears demo state before the unsaved-changes guard fires
detail: On exit-to-public from a dirty demo edit, the guard still sees the dirty flag against already-cleared demo state and modem.replace bounces back to /vacancies/<fixture-id>/edit, where demo_mode is now False and a real get_for_edit fetch fires.
recommended_fix: Run the dirty-edit guard before clearing demo state, or suppress the prompt when the destination exits the demo.

title: After demo exit, in-session navigation (browser Back) to a v- fixture deep link fires real API calls — the is_demo_route guard exists only at boot
location: client/src/client.gleam:499 (_, False arm); 5902-5915 (is_demo_route only called from init)
evidence: '_, False -> handle_browser_change(model, uri, route)' with no is_demo_route check; handle_browser_change then runs 'routes.VacancyDetail(id) | routes.VacancyHandoff(id) -> ... vacancy_api.get_detail(id, ApiReturnedVacancyDetail)'. is_demo_route is invoked only in init: 'case is_demo_route(route) {'
detail: Post-exit Back to /vacancies/v-maples issues real get_detail/leaderboard fetches for a fixture id (401 unauthenticated after clear_demo_state). Boot path re-enters demo; in-session path never does — the two disagree.
recommended_fix: Check is_demo_route in the BrowserChangedUrl _, False arm and re-enter demo (or strip the fetch) for v- prefixed ids.

title: still present since round 3: deep-link demo boots fire only demo_entry; demo_entry_effects has no per-surface capture_event
detail: A fresh boot into /vacancies/v-maples counts demo_entry but not demo_vacancy_open, while the identical in-session navigation counts both. Spec AC7 analytics undercount the shared-URL entry path.
recommended_fix: Fire the matching surface event in demo_entry_effects' route arms.

title: still present since round 3: comparison deep link passes persisted real localStorage ids into the demo store
detail: A real landlord's persisted comparison ids (real UUIDs) are looked up in the demo store on boot; the navigation path's empty-ids guard is skipped, so the demo comparison deep link lands empty/erroring.
recommended_fix: Mirror the navigation path's empty-ids guard and prefer fixture ids in demo.

title: still present since round 3: failed demo seed desyncs model.route from the browser URL
evidence:
'Error(_) -> #(
      Model(..model, route: routes.Landing, demo_mode: False, demo_store: None),
      effect.none(),
    )'
detail: On seed failure the address bar stays /demo while Landing renders; no navigation effect, no feedback, no session check.
recommended_fix: Return modem.replace("/", None, None) so the rendered route matches the URL.

title: still present since round 3: edit deep-link boot renders the empty editable form for the first frame — enter_demo never sets vacancy_edit_loading
detail: The payload lands (r2-B4 fix holds) but the first frame shows the empty form instead of the skeleton on a /vacancies/v-*/edit boot.
recommended_fix: Set vacancy_edit_loading: True in enter_demo when the boot route is VacancyEdit.

title: still present since round 3: demo comparison toggles and sweep-nudge dismissals write to the real product's localStorage
evidence: 'UserToggledComparison(id) -> ... save_comparison_ids(new_ids)' (no demo guard; UserToggledComparison is not intercepted in demo_update.gleam) and 'UserDismissedSweepNudge(application_id) -> ... save_dismissed_sweep_nudges(set.to_list(updated_dismissed))'.
detail: Demo interactions persist demo ids into the real product's localStorage keys; a demo -> signup path hydrates real screens with demo comparison ids. Scope guard: 'no persistence of any kind'.
recommended_fix: Namespace demo storage keys or skip persistence while demo_mode.

title: still present since round 3: UserAcceptedPolicy is not intercepted in demo_update — a surfaced policy modal would fire a real accept_policy POST
evidence:
demo_update.handle: '_ -> fallback(model, msg)' (no UserAcceptedPolicy arm; grep confirms absence). update_inner: 'UserAcceptedPolicy ->
      case model.policy_reaccept_loading {
        True -> #(model, effect.none())
        False -> #(
          Model(..model, policy_reaccept_loading: True),
          auth_api.accept_policy('
detail: Latent: fixture accepted_policy_version is pinned, but a server policy bump surfaces the modal inside demo and the click POSTs with the bogus demo CSRF token. No-network pillar gap of the r1-B8 class.
recommended_fix: Intercept UserAcceptedPolicy in demo_update (no-op with toast), keeping the lint manifest honest.
